meta.description: Fills the underside of a cap with tubes that open in pores, the sponge of a Boletus. The walls between the tubes are where a pattern is 1, the pores where it is 0: the cells of cracks are round pores, the stripes of reaction_diffusion long ones. The layer follows the cap as it opens, like lamellae. Gives the tubes as a mesh.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes. The tubes hang from the underside of the rays and follow them when they move.

pattern.description: The walls of the tubes where it is 1, the pores where it is 0. Its radius is the distance along the cap underside from the axis.

depth.description: How long the tubes are, from the cap underside down to the pores. Read along the cap, alpha 0 at the stipe to 1 at the margin, so a curve shapes it, and for every stipe, so it can follow the size of each mushroom.

free_distance.description: Gap between the tubes and the stipe. Read for every stipe.

pore_depth.description: How far the pores open up into the tubes, 0 = a smooth surface. Read for every stipe.
